contracts.authority_and_safety: Never cross project or subject scope, promote unverified observations, or purge without an auditable scope and recovery policy.
contracts.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing scope, authority, consumer, oracle, rollback, or evidence; preserve the last valid state and report the exact blocker.

inputs.constraints: Authority, time, cost, privacy, compatibility, and mutation limits.
inputs.evidence_context: Known facts, source hashes, prior receipts, and unresolved contradictions.
inputs.target: Explicit file, repository, service, record set, or artifact scope.

contracts.recovery: Resume from the last hash-bound checkpoint after revalidating inputs and affected dependencies; quarantine suspect generated artifacts instead of deleting them.
contracts.trigger: Use when the requested outcome is context budget or when that outcome is a required dependency.
